summary: The crimson 'NuSTAR M82' region reproduces the blue 'Resonant: omega*=45 keV' 95% upper limit of Figure 8 (the paper's new DM-assisted AMR result), with correct particle/coupling/axes, a paper-supported 95% CL (delta-chi2=2.71), faithful conventions, and good numerical agreement at sampled points. Highlight and visibility are correct.

verdict.summary: The crimson 'NuSTAR M82' region reproduces the blue 'Resonant: omega*=45 keV' 95% upper limit of Figure 8 (the paper's new DM-assisted AMR result), with correct particle/coupling/axes, a paper-supported 95% CL (delta-chi2=2.71), faithful conventions, and good numerical agreement at sampled points. Highlight and visibility are correct.

result_identity.evidence: Fig. 8 (p.22) and Sec. 4.1 (p.20): 95% upper limit on axion-photon coupling g_Hgamma vs heavy-axion mass m_H from NuSTAR M82 X-ray data. AxionPhoton coupling, exclusion (is_projection=false). Extraction selected the blue resonant curve, the paper's headline new result, not the dashed nonresonant re-derivation.

novelty.evidence: Genuinely new exclusion: a DM-assisted (AMR) resonant recast of NuSTAR M82 X-ray data producing a new 95% bound that, per p.23, 'beats' the ordinary nonresonant NuSTAR M82 limit for m_H >~ 1.2e-10 eV. The extractor correctly rejected the dashed nonresonant curve (Ning & Safdi re-derivation) as the alternative.

confidence_level.evidence: Fig. 8 caption and p.21: '95% upper limit is where chi2 rises by 2.71 above its minimum' (correct 1-dof 95% CL). In-panel label '95% upper limits'. Supported, not a default/placeholder; data file header 0.95 matches.

conventions.evidence: Fig. 8 axes are g_Hgamma [GeV^-1] vs m_H [eV], 1e-11 to ~8e-9 eV; extraction units/range identical. plotfuncs method does a plain fill_between with no unit/density/polarization transform, consistent with a direct g-vs-m curve; dm_density_assumed/polarization null is appropriate (the DM density enters the physics, not either plotted axis).

numerical_agreement.evidence: Blue curve sampled vs extraction: m_H=1e-11 -> ~3.6e-12 (ext 3.65e-12); minimum near m_H~3.2e-10 -> ~1.59e-12 (ext 1.591e-12 at 3.18e-10); m_H~1e-9 -> ~6.1e-12 (ext 6.09e-12); right endpoint m_H~8e-9 -> ~1.19e-10 (ext 1.19e-10). The local bump near 1e-10 is reproduced. No single headline number is quoted in text, consistent with notes.

highlight_target.evidence: Highlighted PNGs show the red region confined to the new curve's m_H range (1e-11-8e-9 eV) at g~1.6e-12-1.2e-10 GeV^-1, matching Fig. 8's blue curve. No unrelated limit is accented.

visibility.evidence: Full view x-range to 1e-8 eV, y to 1e-9 GeV^-1 contains the whole curve; label 'NuSTAR M82' present; the genuinely new excluded strip (deeper reach near m_H~3e-10) is visible below existing grey bounds in the highlighted view; boundaries interpretable.

findings.description: Below m_H ~ 1.2e-10 eV the plotted resonant curve is weaker (higher g) than the ordinary nonresonant NuSTAR M82 bound, and the paper (p.23) cautions that the rising low-mass suppression tail 'depends on extrapolating the adopted DM profile beyond its established validity and should not be interpreted as a reliable prediction of stronger suppression.' Plotting the full curve is conservative (a weaker bound there) and faithful to the paper, so not blocking, but reviewers should note the sub-1.2e-10 portion adds no new exclusion beyond existing bounds.
findings.evidence: Fig. 8 shows blue above dashed for m_H < ~1.2e-10; p.23 'Comparison with existing bounds' and 'rising tail' caveat.
findings.requested_change: None required; optionally note in docs that only m_H >~ 1.2e-10 eV improves on the ordinary NuSTAR M82 limit.

findings.description: The on-plot label reads 'NuSTAR M82', identical to the conventional (nonresonant, Ning & Safdi) NuSTAR M82 limit; the internal name NuSTAR_M82_AMR_2026 distinguishes it but the visible label does not, risking confusion with the standard bound.
findings.evidence: plotfuncs text label '{\bf NuSTAR M82}'; alternatives field notes the nonresonant curve is a re-derivation of the Ning & Safdi NuSTAR M82 analysis.
findings.requested_change: Optionally clarify the on-plot label (e.g. 'NuSTAR M82 (AMR)') to distinguish the DM-assisted resonant result from the standard NuSTAR M82 limit.
